```{r}
library(quantmod)

tickers <- c("AAPL", "MSFT", "JPM", "JNJ")

prices <- lapply(tickers, function(ticker) {
  stock <- getSymbols(
    ticker,
    src = "yahoo",
    from = "2021-09-01",
    to = "2026-09-28",
    auto.assign = FALSE
  )

  Ad(stock)
})

names(prices) <- tickers
```

```{r}
portfolio_prices <- do.call(
  merge,
  c(prices, all = FALSE)
)

colnames(portfolio_prices) <- tickers


portfolio_returns <- do.call(
  merge,
  lapply(
    1:ncol(portfolio_prices),
    function(i) Delt(portfolio_prices[, i])
  )
)

portfolio_returns <- na.omit(portfolio_returns)

colnames(portfolio_returns) <- tickers

head(portfolio_returns)
```

```{r}
# Daily expected returns
daily_means <- colMeans(portfolio_returns)

# Daily volatility
daily_volatility <- apply(
  portfolio_returns,
  2,
  sd
)

# Annualised estimates
annual_means <- daily_means * 252

annual_volatility <- daily_volatility * sqrt(252)

round(annual_means, 4)
round(annual_volatility, 4)
```

```{r}
# Daily covariance matrix
daily_cov <- cov(portfolio_returns)

# Annualised covariance matrix
annual_cov <- daily_cov * 252

# Correlation matrix
correlation_matrix <- cor(portfolio_returns)

round(annual_cov, 4)
round(correlation_matrix, 3)
```

```{r}
# Define our portfolio weights
weights <- c(0.30, 0.25, 0.25, 0.20)

# Calculate expected annual portfolio return
portfolio_mean <- sum(weights * annual_means)

portfolio_mean

portfolio_variance <- as.numeric(
  t(weights) %*% annual_cov %*% weights
)

# Calculate portfolio volatility
portfolio_volatility <- sqrt(portfolio_variance)

portfolio_volatility
   
  
```

```{r}
set.seed(123)

# Number of simulations
n_simulations <- 10000

# Generate hypothetical annual returns
simulated_returns <- rnorm(
  n = n_simulations,
  mean = portfolio_mean,
  sd = portfolio_volatility
)

# Inspect the first six results
head(simulated_returns)
```

```{r}
#initial inestment 
initial_value <- 10000

# Calculate simulated final values
final_values <- initial_value *
  (1 + simulated_returns)

# Inspect the results
head(final_values)

# Calculate the average final value
mean(final_values)
  
```

```{r}
hist(

abline(

```

```{r}
)

head(Z)
```

```{r}

# Obtain the Cholesky factor
U <- chol(annual_cov)

# Transform independent observations
correlated_returns <- Z %*% U

# Add historical expected returns
simulated_stock_returns <- sweep(
  correlated_returns,
  2,
  annual_means,
  "+"
)

head(simulated_stock_returns)
  
```

```{r}
simulated_portfolio_returns <-
  simulated_stock_returns %*% weights

head(simulated_portfolio_returns)
mean(simulated_portfolio_returns)
```


```{r}
##calculating kurtosis, a measure of how heavy the tails of a distribution are.
aapl_returns <- as.numeric(portfolio_returns$AAPL)

aapl_mean <- mean(aapl_returns)
aapl_sd <- sd(aapl_returns)

aapl_kurtosis <- mean(
  ((aapl_returns - aapl_mean) / aapl_sd)^4
)

aapl_kurtosis
```

```{r}
stressed_portfolio_variance <- as.numeric(
  t(weights) %*% stressed_cov %*% weights
)

  sqrt(stressed_portfolio_variance)

stressed_portfolio_volatility
```

```{r}
# ---------------------------------------------------------
# MONTE CARLO PORTFOLIO PATH SIMULATION
# ---------------------------------------------------------

set.seed(123)

# Daily historical parameters
path_daily_means <- colMeans(portfolio_returns)
path_daily_cov <- cov(portfolio_returns)

# Simulation settings
n_days <- 252
n_paths <- 500
initial_value <- 10000

# Cholesky decomposition of daily covariance matrix
U_daily <- chol(path_daily_cov)

# Create matrix to store portfolio values
portfolio_paths <- matrix(
  NA,
  nrow = n_days + 1,
  ncol = n_paths
)

# Every simulation starts at £10,000
portfolio_paths[1, ] <- initial_value

# Simulate each trading day
for (day in 1:n_days) {

  # Generate independent standard Normal returns
  Z_daily <- matrix(
    rnorm(n_paths * 4),
    nrow = n_paths,
    ncol = 4
  )

  # Introduce historical covariance structure
  correlated_daily_returns <- Z_daily %*% U_daily

  # Add expected daily returns
  simulated_daily_stock_returns <- sweep(
    correlated_daily_returns,
    2,
    path_daily_means,
    "+"
  )

  # Calculate portfolio return for each path
  simulated_daily_portfolio_returns <-
    simulated_daily_stock_returns %*% weights

  # Update portfolio values
  portfolio_paths[day + 1, ] <-
    portfolio_paths[day, ] *
    (1 + simulated_daily_portfolio_returns)
}

# Plot the simulated paths
matplot(
  0:n_days,
  portfolio_paths,
  type = "l",
  lty = 1,
  xlab = "Trading Day",
  ylab = "Portfolio Value (£)",
  main = "Monte Carlo Simulation of Portfolio Value"
)

# Add initial portfolio value as reference
abline(
  h = initial_value,
  lty = 2,
  lwd = 2
)
# Starting portfolio value
abline(
  h = initial_value,
  lty = 2,
  lwd = 2
)
median_path <- apply(
  portfolio_paths,
  1,
  median
)

lines(
  0:n_days,
  median_path,
  lwd = 4
)
legend(
  "topleft",
  legend = c(
    "Simulated Paths",
    "Median Path",
    "Initial Value"
  ),
  lty = c(1, 1, 2),
  lwd = c(1, 4, 2)
)
```

